title: Install owned agent skills only from approved hash-locked artifacts with rollback
problem: An unpinned skill installer may bypass approval rules or replace files with mutable downloads; a failed upgrade can leave a partial or unsafe installation.
resolution: Separate the approval policy from exact artifact hashes. Stage reviewed local packages, verify source and installed digests, preserve a complete backup, replace only absent destinations and test a rollback against conflicts and partial failure.
applicability: Updating repository-owned skills from vetted local artifacts under a Windows PowerShell development workflow, with explicit approval for the exact package.
doNotUseWhen: Packages come from unaudited external sources or a different manager owns the destination; do not assume this implements a generic dependency manager.
